suggestions.headline: Join an autoclave cycle that is already running on Tuesday
suggestions.why: Another group runs a 45% load at 16:00 the same day. Your 40% load fits in it, so one full cycle (6 kWh) is avoided.
suggestions.tradeoff: Your items must be ready by 16:00 instead of 17:00.

suggestions.headline: Image on Friday afternoon instead of Thursday evening
suggestions.why: The grid averages ~128 g/kWh on Fri 12:00–16:00 vs ~381 on Thu 19:00–23:00, and the lasers are already warm from the session before.
suggestions.tradeoff: Imaging happens 17 hours later than planned.

suppressed.detail: Bioreactor conditioning: protocol timing fixed, safety interlock.
Continuous culture in the incubator cannot be interrupted.
